fijate: Fíjate en la superficie de los conidios grandes.
claves: Dos macroconidios tuberculados. H. capsulatum crece en suelo contaminado con excremento de murciélagos o aves; las esporas se respiran al remover la tierra; la histoplasmosis no se pasa de persona a persona.

imagen.descripcionOriginal: ID#: 4023 Description: This photomicrograph shows two tuberculate macroconida of the Jamaican isolate of Histoplasma capsulatum. Histoplasma capsulatum grows in soil, and material contaminated with bat or bird droppings. Spores become airborne when contaminated soil is disturbed, and breathing the spores causes histoplasmosis, a disease not transmitted from person to person.
